facts.text: Highland Village was incorporated as a city on Valentine’s Day in February 1963, when a group of lakeside residents decided to make their homes permanent.
The city’s early growth centered along the northern shore of Lewisville Lake, where many of the first residents were Dallas professionals looking for weekend retreats.
Doubletree Ranch Park today sits on land that once belonged to the original ranch that helped shape Highland Village’s early landscape.
Public transit arrived in 2008 when DCTA began a bus service that connected Highland Village to the broader DCTA network.
In 2020, DCTA replaced its Highland Village Connect Shuttle with a Lyft discount program to improve network efficiency.
The city’s on‑demand GoZone service launched in September 2021, partnering with Via Transportation to replace the Lyft program and offer flexible rides.
